title: Who Wakes Next
text: {who} has asked a favour. The next embryo out of the cryo bank should come from the {whoLine} line: their own family. The bank's rule is rarest line first, to keep the colony's genes diverse.

choices.label: Keep the rule
choices.reply: "Rarest line first. Everyone's family is the colony's family." {who} says they understand. They don't look like it.

choices.label: Grant it
choices.reply: The next pod will hold a {whoLine} child. {who} cries, then laughs, then goes to tell everyone.
